blocks.title: Rolling a check
blocks.text: Every check rolls a d100. The target is the crew member's skill plus the ship system's rating, times 5, plus the hazard's difficulty. A roll at or under the target succeeds.

sections.title: Difficulty
sections.text: A routine hazard adds 0, a hard one -10, a severe one -20, and an extreme one -30.

sections.title: Damage
sections.text: A failed check against a hazard that deals damage costs the ship that many d10s of hull.
